provenance.source: IMSA / Al Kamel Timing 3 Sector Map
IMSA / Al Kamel Timing All Sections Map

position.registration_model: window scatter split into estimator noise (0.17/0.19 m E/N, from two lidar surveys) and non-rigid distortion

checks.note: independent lidar surveys; their difference bounds both references' errors

selection.rule: min(absolute CE95 + 4 m x unseen share)

racing_line.method: minimum curvature inside the measured edges (car half width kept off each edge), quasi-steady-state lap: grip with downforce, power, braking, friction ellipse
racing_line.limitations: model, not a measurement: no elevation, no kerbs, a generic car

imagery.name: USDA NAIP via USGS The National Map
imagery.horizontal_accuracy: NAIP contract: 95% of well-defined points within 4 m (2016+); not tested per acquisition

seed.name: layout centerline (OpenStreetMap)
seed.use: seed only: fixes lap order, origin and direction; the edges are measured
